newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA COACH FEARS INJURIES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SOUTH AFRICA COACH FEARS INJURIES.

text.p: Springbok coach Andre Markgraaff is worried that a bruising Currie Cup final between Transvaaal and Natal on Saturday might result in injuries to key national squad players.
"I'll be keeping my eye on the two number 10s very closely because they are key players -- particularly Henry Honiball," he said on Monday.
"He is struggling with his hamstring and I'm worried that he might get injured.
Markgraaff said the only worries in his squad to tour Argentina, France and Wales at present were lock Krynauw Otto (head cold) and fullback Theo van Rensburg (leg injury).
"But both should come right in the next few days," he said.

Markgraaff said his team might play an extra game in Wales. "At the moment they are without a match for the last 12 days or so of our tour and the tour management is looking at the possibility of an extra fixture. But nothing has been confirmed yet."

Markgraaff was forced to add three more names to his 36-strong squad at the weekend. Injuries have ruled out Griqualand West utility back Boeta Wessels and Transvaal wing Pieter Hendriks. They were replaced by Transvaal's Joe Gillingham and Western Province's Justin Swart respectively.

Free State prop Os du Randt, who ruled himself out of the tour on Thursday, has been replaced by Natal tighthead Adrian Garvey, who represented Zimbabwe in 1993 but has now served the three-year qualification period.
